name: reminders
description: Manage Apple Reminders through direct APIs first and deterministic AppleScript Accessibility for UI-only features.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Apple Reminders without visual automation
interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, edit, complete, and organize Apple Reminders. Use remindctl or EventKit for semantic operations, then deterministic AppleScript Accessibility for native tags, custom Smart Lists, and other UI-only fields before falling back to model-driven Computer Use.
